'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Eight [[construction worker]]s are killed near [[Sevastopol]], [[Crimea]], in an overnight fire at a [[barracks]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/seven-dead-construction-site-fire-crimea-russian-installed-governor-2023-02-02/?ref=upstract.com (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2020–2023 H5N8 outbreak]]
**The [[UK Health Security Agency]] confirms that [[avian influenza]] has crossed over to several wild mammals, including [[fox]]es, [[otter]]s and [[pinniped|seals]]. The agency says that the risk to humans remains very low, however, there will now be more "targeted surveillance" and testing of animals. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-64474594 (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Israel–Sudan relations]]
**[[Israel–Sudan normalization agreement]]
***[[Israel]] and [[Sudan]] announce the finalisation of a deal to normalize relations between the two countries. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/israeli-foreign-minister-heads-delegation-discuss-sudan-normalisation-2023-02-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[List of high-altitude object events in 2023|High-altitude object events in 2023]]
**[[2023 Chinese balloon incident]]
***The [[United States Department of Defense]] monitors a [[high-altitude balloon]] from [[China]] flying over [[Montana]]. The Chinese [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China|Foreign Affairs Ministry]] says the balloon is used for civilian  meteorological research and had drifted off-course due to unexpected weather. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/pentagon-says-its-tracking-suspected-chinese-spy-balloon-over-us-3748701 (AFP via NDTV)] [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2023/feb/03/china-spy-balloon-secretary-of-state-trip-postponed (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Philippines–United States relations]]
**The [[Philippines]] permits the [[U.S. Armed Forces]] access to an additional four [[military base]]s, thereby expediting the full implementation of the [[Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230202-philippines-to-expand-us-access-to-military-bases-official (AFP via France 24)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[War on terror]]
**The [[United States]] releases [[Majid Khan (detainee)|Majid Khan]] from the [[Guantanamo Bay detention camp|Guantanamo Bay prison]] and transfers him to [[Belize]]. Khan had been captured in 2003 in [[Pakistan]] and was being held on accusations of helping [[al-Qaeda]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-transfers-pakistani-guantanamo-bay-detainee-2023-02-02/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Qatar corruption scandal at the European Parliament]]
**Two [[Member of the European Parliament|MEPs]], [[Andrea Cozzolino]] and [[Marc Tarabella]], have their [[legal immunity]] revoked by [[European Union]] lawmakers amid an investigation into [[money laundering]] and [[bribery]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-64495562 (BBC News)]
